name: political-whatsapp-channels
title: Political party WhatsApp channels
description: European political parties' presence on WhatsApp, with public follower counts of their Channels tracked over time. Follower readings are append-only CSV; the party registry, observed profiles and ISO 3166 geography are JSON. See README.md for the full methodology, field definitions and limitations.

resources.name: observations
resources.title: Follower readings
resources.description: Append-only follower readings, one row per check of one surface. Files are partitioned by month as datasets/party-channels/observations/<YYYY-MM>.csv and all share this schema. Rows are never edited or deleted, so the git history of that directory is the complete measurement record. A failed check is recorded with a status and no follower number; a count is never stored as 0 to mean 'unknown'.

fields.name: checked_at
fields.title: Checked at
fields.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the check, second precision.

fields.name: party_id
fields.title: Party id
fields.description: Registry party id; join key to the registry (parties/*.json).

fields.name: channel_id
fields.title: Surface id
fields.description: The surface's id: a Channel id, a group/community invite code, or a phone number. Join key to profiles.json.

fields.name: status
fields.title: Status
fields.description: Outcome of the read. 'ok' is the only status that carries a follower count.

fields.name: followers
fields.title: Followers
fields.description: Follower count. Empty unless status is 'ok'. Never 0 standing in for 'unknown'.

fields.name: precision
fields.title: Precision
fields.description: Whether the source printed the exact number ('exact') or a rounded one ('rounded'). WhatsApp prints the whole number only in some languages, so the collector requests de-DE and falls back to it-IT.

fields.name: locale
fields.title: Locale
fields.description: The Accept-Language value that produced the reading, e.g. de-DE.

fields.name: channel_name
fields.title: Channel name
fields.description: The surface's own name at check time (observed, may change between checks).

fields.name: http_status
fields.title: HTTP status
fields.description: The HTTP response status, when there was one.

fields.name: kind
fields.title: Surface kind
fields.description: The kind of WhatsApp surface. Only a Channel publishes a follower count.

resources.name: registry
resources.title: Party registry
resources.description: The curated registry: one JSON file per country (parties/<iso2>.json, lowercase) plus parties/_<continent>.json for supranational parties with no country (e.g. _europe.json). Each file is an object with a 'country' code (absent in the _continent files) and a 'parties' array. One entry is one party in one place, carrying: id (stable join key, never renamed), name, abbreviation, englishName, the place fields (country from the filename, optional region as an ISO 3166-2 code, optional free-text city, or continent/worldwide for supranational/global entries), parentId (linking a branch to its national party), website, epGroup (European Parliament group), optional europarty, optional orientation with a required orientationSource when overridden, cadence, a verified date, an optional dated noChannel flag, and up to one 'channel' surface plus one 'other' surface. A surface has kind/url/id/added and an optional source; a channel may be flagged personal. All fields are documented in README.md.

resources.name: profiles
resources.title: Observed channel profiles
resources.description: Observed state per surface, overwritten on each check: title, description, the observed CDN image URL and a stable mirrored avatar path, the latest follower count and precision, the last status, the verification-badge flag, and the time it was seen. Keyed by surface id. These are observed (not curated) values, kept apart from the registry so a channel rename is never confused with a typo.

resources.name: places-countries
resources.title: Countries (ISO 3166-1)
resources.description: European countries with ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, names, slugs and capital. Generated reference table; places are referenced by code, never by typed-in name.

resources.name: places-regions
resources.title: Regions (ISO 3166-2)
resources.description: Country subdivisions with ISO 3166-2 codes, parent country code, names, slugs and subdivision type.
